description: This file defines the 'Header' struct and associated methods for parsing and generating gettext header comments in a localization context.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Represents the header information in gettext PO files, including metadata fields.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Parses a Message object to populate the Header fields based on header comment lines.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Converts the Header object into a Message with the header string.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Generates the string representation of the header in PO file format.
